card.name: "for" after contraception-during-treatment "and"
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after "during treatment with [drug] and" in advice on contraception for male patients. It also fires on "for" or "complete" in "See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning".

modes.label: Contraception duration
modes.description: "for" after "and" in advice to use effective contraception during treatment and for months afterward.
